skills.name: trace-validation
skills.description: Verify that a trace_id is consistent across all events written to the evolution_decisions.jsonl ledger, and that the closed loop reaches final_status=closed_loop_completed.

skills.name: ledger-append
skills.description: Append a structured event to the evolution_decisions.jsonl ledger via the append_event tool. The event must include event_type, trace_id, and final_status.
